sources.snippet: Introduction If you've ever wondered how AI can understand whether a piece of text is positive, negative, or neutral, you're in the right place. Sentiment analysis is one of the most practical applications of natural language processing, and thanks to Hugging Face, you can build your first working model in just a few minutes—no PhD required.
